tagline.en: The FAST variant of pi0 — an autoregressive VLA policy using tokenized actions for faster control.
tagline.zh: pi0 的 FAST 变体——用 token 化动作的自回归 VLA 策略，控制更快。

en: pi0-FAST is a variant of Physical Intelligence's pi0 vision-language-action model, released through the OpenPI project. Instead of a flow-based action expert, it predicts actions as discrete tokens using the FAST action tokenization, letting the policy generate actions autoregressively.

Tokenized actions let pi0-FAST reuse a compact, transformer-style decoding path, an alternative design point to the flow-based pi0 that can suit different control needs. In WorldFoundry it runs on the in-tree OpenPI runtime with a DROID-oriented FAST configuration.
This is an action-generation model: it emits an action trace rather than video. The pi0-FAST checkpoint is obtained separately before you roll it out.
zh: pi0-FAST 是 Physical Intelligence 的 pi0 视觉-语言-动作模型的一个变体，通过 OpenPI 项目发布。它不采用基于 flow 的动作专家，而是用 FAST 动作 token 化把动作预测为离散 token，让策略以自回归方式生成动作。
token 化动作让 pi0-FAST 得以复用一条紧凑的 transformer 式解码路径，是相对基于 flow 的 pi0 的另一种设计取向，可适配不同的控制需求。在 WorldFoundry 中，它运行于内置 OpenPI 运行时，并采用面向 DROID 的 FAST 配置。
这是一个动作生成模型：它输出的是动作轨迹而非视频。pi0-FAST 的 checkpoint 需在推演前单独获取。

whenToUse.en: Choose pi0-FAST when you want a vision-language-action policy with tokenized, autoregressive action decoding — an alternative to the flow-based pi0 for robot control.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个采用 token 化、自回归动作解码的视觉-语言-动作策略时，可选择 pi0-FAST——它是基于 flow 的 pi0 之外的另一种机器人控制选项。

notFor.en: An action-generation policy, not a video model — it outputs action traces. The pi0-FAST checkpoint is supplied separately.
notFor.zh: 它是动作生成策略，而非视频模型——输出的是动作轨迹。pi0-FAST 的 checkpoint 需单独提供。
